measured.absolutePositionCaveat: Detail restoration retains a global fully-measured-prefix difference while passing separate viewport-alignment and assigned-row-placement assertions. An estimated, unmeasured prefix is the likely cause; no claim that all restored absolute document coordinates are within 1px. Exact measured differences are retained above.
measured.scope: Retained coordinate attachments after settling; this is not a maximum across every frame or every assertCoverage call.
measured.anchorScope: Suite-wide numeric anchor deltas were not retained; thresholds are reported. The duplicate-ID attachment records its actual alignment delta. The separately retained older-source detail diagnostic has its own source hash.

previousSourceDetailLocalPlacement.coordinateBasis: Row inline transform is produced from vi.start - scrollMargin; expected viewport top is root viewport top + that transform.

acceptanceClarification: The global fully-measured-prefix 1px target is not met or certified for detail restoration. Initial/warmed fixed-reference cases satisfy the scoped 1px assertions. Detail acceptance is complete viewport ID coverage, assigned virtual-row placement, and the existing 12vh + 8px viewport alignment within 2px. The older-source diagnostic is labeled separately and is not final-source evidence.

assertions.completeViewportIdCoverage: All expected IDs present, overscan allowed.
assertions.coreReferencePositionCssPx: At most 1 for 390/820/1440 widths and initial upper offsets 0/180/3000.
assertions.assignedVirtualRowPlacementCssPx: At most 1 wherever assertCoverage runs, comparing actual DOM top against root viewport top plus the assigned inline transform. This is not a fully measured prefix-coordinate assertion.
assertions.readingAnchorCssPx: At most 2 for width changes, actual card layout changes, generation mismatch; late upper-height reader alignment additionally uses toBeCloseTo(..., 0), i.e. less than 0.5.
assertions.detailReturnAlignmentCssPx: At most 2 from the existing 12vh + 8px alignment.
assertions.topReaderScrollY: Exactly 0, including same-task return to top plus upper growth.
assertions.cancellationScrollYCssPx: At most 2 after the delayed page has committed at least 80 IDs and another 1000ms (URL/detail/middle), or 750ms (column/pending append).

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation; no physical mobile device, Safari, native scrollbar/autoscroll acceptance, or external media verification.
Geometry harness baseline supplies exact sizes and is independent of React/DOM/ResizeObserver integration.
Rows outside the viewport may be virtualized; viewport coverage is the criterion.
